profile.headline: Principal Consultant at Ness Systems Ltd
profile.summary: I have 30 years' experience in software development, technical leadership, and software architecture. I am expert in Ruby on Rails and in specifying and designing robust software architectures to drive impactful solutions to complex technical challenges. My professional journey includes significant contributions to and oversight of projects written in Python, C++ and Node.js with TypeScript. I am expert in Elasticsearch/Opensearch; also in advanced API design using standards like OpenAPI, Swagger, JSON:API and GraphQL. I have a strong University research foundation, bolstered by a Computing Science PhD in computational linguistics for legal technology, which allows me to bridge academia and industry.

positions.title: Principal Consultant
positions.description:
• Provide remote software engineering consultancy specializing in data-intensive tasks and environments.  
• Develop web applications with a focus on online search and retrieval capabilities.  
• Implement data integration solutions across multimedia asset types using Elasticsearch/Opensearch, NoSketchEngine and Content-Based Multimedia Retrieval.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Implemented automatic LLM-based Trust and Safety content moderation API for user-generated content on Warner mobile applications, ensuring compliance and maintenance of a welcoming and inclusive platform.  
• Developed and maintained scalable applications using Node.js and TypeScript.
• Infrastructure runs on AWS with EC2 and ECS with GitHub Actions-based CI/CD.

positions.title: Technical Lead Manager
positions.description:
• Provided technical leadership in Ruby on Rails for a team of technical leads, fostering collaboration and innovation.  
• Led the Data Team in implementing and maintaining ticketing data ingestion pipelines from nearly 100 partners.  
• Created Engineering Design Documents in response to Product Strategy Reviews and Product Requirement Documents.  These were iterated on by the team up until approval and engineering acceptance, after which development commenced.

positions.title: Development Team Lead
positions.description:
• Led a development team of 5 developers and 1 QA tester in creating a robust backend API for a Financial Technology (Fintech) platform using Ruby on Rails and a dynamic frontend with React.  
• Collaborated closely with Product Owners to translate business requirements into actionable technical strategies and documentation.  
• Implemented Agile project management methodologies using JIRA and Confluence to streamline development processes and enhance team productivity.

positions.title: Acting Development Team Lead
positions.description:
• Led a development team of 5 developers and 1 QA tester in creating a robust backend API for a Financial Technology (Fintech) platform using Ruby on Rails and a dynamic frontend with React.  
• Collaborated closely with Product Owners to translate business requirements into actionable technical strategies and documentation.  
• Implemented Agile project management methodologies using JIRA and Confluence to streamline development processes and enhance team productivity.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed backend solutions for a financial factoring company, enhancing cash flow management for SMEs.  
• Utilized Ruby on Rails API framework to create efficient and scalable software applications.  
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of financial processes.

positions.title: Honorary Research Fellow
positions.description:
• Contributed to research activities and teaching within the School of Computing at the University of St Andrews.  
• Furthered the outputs from my PhD thesis to enhance academic knowledge and innovation.  
• Collaborated with faculty and students to foster a vibrant research community.

positions.title: PhD Research Student
positions.description:
• Created the LARC prototype legal information search and retrieval platform in C++ and Ruby.
• Conducted in-depth research in Human Computer Interaction at the University of St Andrews.  
• Proposed innovative visualizations for hierarchies of precedent in English case law.  
• Analyzed linguistic links between case law reports to enhance legal understanding.  
• Developed critical skills in research methodology, data analysis, and visualization techniques.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed automatic image analysis and data redaction software for the 1939 National Register of Great Britain. 
• Collaborated on creating and maintaining workflow tools for transcription correction of census records and digital materials.  
• Stack was predominantly Python and Ruby with Pecona MySQL.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Led the development of software solutions to analyze land use change scenarios using R.  
• Engaged in collaborative research and iterative refinement efforts to enhance the project's technical outputs.  
• Authored and published a final research paper to a reputable academic journal on the outputs of this work.

positions.title: Image Retrieval Software Consultant
positions.description:
• Developed and tested prototype image retrieval systems that respond to image-based queries.  
• Programmed multimedia asset search and retreival software in C++ and Java.  
• Implemented performance-enhancing algorithms for content-based image retrieval, enhancing search accuracy through steps such as blur identification in similarity computation.

positions.title: Head of Research and Development - Canan Ltd
positions.description:
• Oversaw software development and service provision for large-scale IT projects.  
• Submitted research papers to academic conferences, showcasing company innovations.  
• Provided technical project planning and management for key clients.

positions.title: Research and Development Specialist - Canan Ltd
positions.description:
• Developed the PhraseBox text mining and concordancing application for Learning and Teaching Scotland.  
• Collaborated with academics from the UK and Czech Republic to enhance educational tools.  
• Utilized advanced software development skills across various languages and platforms, including Java, PHP and C++.  
• Contributed to multimedia creation projects, ensuring high-quality deliverables.

positions.title: Knowledge Transfer Associate and Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed web and multimedia solutions for educational and language acquisition projects  
• Associate on the Knowledge Transfer programme between Canan Ltd and Edinburgh Napier University, which received recognition for excellence the Department for Trade and Industry.  
• Helped rank the project as the best in Scotland and among the top eight in the UK for the national KTP scheme.

positions.title: Freelance web designer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed websites for various clients in the Inverness area, enhancing their online presence.  
• Implemented e-commerce systems to facilitate online transactions for small businesses and individuals, using JShop Pro and (latterly) OSCommerce.

honors.title: Certificate of Excellence for Knowledge Transfer Partnership
honors.description: An award for excellence and for the results achieved in the Knowledge Transfer Partnership programme between Edinburgh Napier University and Canan Ltd between 2001 and 2004.  I was employed as the Knowledge Transfer Associate on this programme.  The programme and its results were judged to be the best in Scotland and one of the top eight in the UK for that round of the scheme.
honors.issuer: Issued by Department for Trade and Industry · Jan 2004

honors.title: Neil Gunn Writing Competition Runner-up
honors.description: A runner-up award for an original short story.

projects.title: Amicus Curiae - A Language Analysis platform for Lawyers
projects.description: Literally - Friend of the Court.  This is the successor project to the work that I undertook during my PhD.  It is an online search and retrieval and linguistic analysis platform for lawyers which operates on a corpus of 1 billion words of English legal caselaw and legislation.  It is designed to help foster and promote legal research skills in law students and early-stage legal professionals.

projects.title: Eagle Image Search - a Content-Based Image Retrieval platform
projects.description: A search engine which allows the user to search for images based upon queries which are themselves images or videos.  It uses different image features and descriptors to map similarities between an input image and candidates from a database of potential matches.  The system is designed to work on corpora of billions of candidate images.

publications.title: Corpus Linguistics for the Exploration of Legal Precedent
Corpora and software tools for education and the law
publications.publisher: University of Saarland, Saarbrücken, Germany · Oct 11, 2017
